paragraphs: I'm applying for the part-time Venture Capital Intern role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Tower Research Ventures backs and builds companies at the edge of data and technology, and I'd like to spend this academic year learning how a technical investor sizes up early-stage businesses.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I built AI powered analytical dashboards for the business. In my MBA coursework I valued J.M. Smucker with comps and a DCF and built an LBO model, so I'm comfortable with valuation work and reading financial statements closely.
I can bring careful market and company research, clean models and clear write-ups to the team, and I can commit steady hours alongside my classes this semester. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
